stages.label: Intake
stages.goal: Resolve requested outcome, repository, Site, target environment and allowed change boundary.

stages.label: Repository Discovery
stages.goal: Inspect existing stack, structure, commands, manifest, adapters, migrations and tests before modification.

stages.label: Manifest Resolution
stages.goal: Resolve the exact Site Manifest and pinned Contract/API versions.

stages.label: Registry Resolution
stages.goal: Resolve canonical contracts, Modules, Capabilities, APIs, Permissions, Events, Webhooks, Integrations and UI metadata.

stages.label: Requirement Mapping
stages.goal: Map each requested behavior to canonical NEXT F definitions and identify missing coverage.

stages.label: Implementation Plan
stages.goal: Define the smallest compatible change set, boundaries, tests, migrations and risks.

stages.label: Implementation
stages.goal: Implement customer-specific behavior against canonical contracts without parallel architecture.

stages.label: Verification
stages.goal: Run relevant syntax, type, lint, test, build, migration and contract checks that are available.

stages.label: Deviation Review
stages.goal: Compare implementation with Manifest/contracts and record every deviation or extension.

stages.label: Handoff
stages.goal: Produce a complete implementation report and unresolved-risk summary.
